The hottest heat source, up to 1,400°C. It burns lava from its tank, and lava and magma blocks touching it add heat for free, without being used up.
Fill it with lava buckets in the slot, by right-clicking with a bucket, or with pipes. Pair it with an Electric Pump over a lava lake. An Arc Melter set on top keeps it fed with lava made from cobblestone.
